obligations.summary: National public authorities or bodies supervising fundamental rights obligations must have the power to request and access any documentation created or maintained under this Regulation in accessible language and format when necessary for fulfilling their mandates, and must inform the relevant market surveillance authority of any such request.
exceptions: Access is limited to documentation necessary for effectively fulfilling mandates within the limits of their jurisdiction.

obligations.summary: Each Member State must, by 2 November 2024, identify the public authorities or bodies referred to in Article 77(1), make a list of them publicly available, notify the list to the Commission and other Member States, and keep the list up to date.

Where documentation is insufficient to ascertain whether a fundamental rights infringement has occurred, the relevant public authority or body may make a reasoned request to the market surveillance authority to organise technical testing of the high-risk AI system, and the market surveillance authority must organise such testing with close involvement of the requesting authority within a reasonable time.
exceptions: A reasoned request is required before the market surveillance authority is obliged to organise testing.

obligations.summary: Any information or documentation obtained by national public authorities or bodies pursuant to Article 77 must be treated in accordance with the confidentiality obligations set out in Article 78.
